translations.literal: Three stars west of Eastern Salt, north-south in a row, are called Penalty Star—it governs receiving gold ransom.
translations.idiomatic: Three Penalty stars west of Eastern Salt govern gold ransom.

sentences.zh: 鍵閉一星，在房東北，近鉤鈐，主關鑰。

translations.literal: Key and Lock is one star northeast of Fang, near Gouqian—it governs keys and locks.
translations.idiomatic: Key and Lock northeast of Fang near Gouqian guards locks.

sentences.zh: 天市垣二十二星，在房心東北，主權衡，主聚眾。

translations.literal: The Celestial Market Enclosure is twenty-two stars northeast of Heart and Fang—it governs the balance scale and gathering multitudes.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-two Celestial Market stars northeast of Heart and Fang govern scales and crowds.

sentences.zh: 一曰天旗庭，主斬戮之事也。

translations.literal: Also called the Celestial Banner Court—it governs executions and slayings.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Banner Court governing executions.

sentences.zh: 市中星眾潤澤則歲實，星稀則歲虛。

translations.literal: When market stars are many and moist, the harvest is abundant; when sparse, the harvest is poor.
translations.idiomatic: Many moist market stars mean rich harvests; sparse stars mean poor ones.

sentences.zh: 熒惑守之，戮不忠之臣。

translations.literal: If Mars lodges there, disloyal ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: Mars lodging there executes disloyal ministers.

sentences.zh: 又曰，若怒角守之，戮者臣殺主。

translations.literal: It is also said: if angry with horns and lodging, the executed minister kills the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Also: angry horned Mars there means ministers kill the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 慧星除之，為徙市易都。

translations.literal: If a comet clears it, the market moves and the capital changes.
translations.idiomatic: A comet clearing it moves the market and changes the capital.

sentences.zh: 客星入之，兵大起，出之有貴喪。

translations.literal: If a guest star enters, great war rises; if it exits, noble mourning occurs.
translations.idiomatic: Guest star entry brings war; exit brings noble death.

sentences.zh: 市中六星臨箕，曰市樓市府也，主市價律度。

translations.literal: Six stars in the market near Ji are called Market Tower—the market administration, governing market prices and standards.
translations.idiomatic: Six Market Tower stars by Ji govern prices and market law.

sentences.zh: 其陽為金錢，其陰為珠玉。

translations.literal: Their yang side is money; yin side pearls and jade.
translations.idiomatic: Yang side is coin; yin side gems.

sentences.zh: 變見，各以所主占之。

translations.literal: Changes are interpreted each by what they govern.
translations.idiomatic: Changes are read by each star's domain.

sentences.zh: 北四星曰天斛，主量者也。

translations.literal: Four northern stars are called Celestial Dipper—they govern measure.
translations.idiomatic: Four northern Celestial Dipper stars govern measuring.

sentences.zh: 斛西北二星曰列肆，主寶玉之貨。

translations.literal: Two stars northwest of the Dipper are called Ranked Shops—they govern treasures of jade.
translations.idiomatic: Two Ranked Shop stars northwest govern jade goods.

sentences.zh: 市門左星內二星曰車肆，主眾賈之區。

translations.literal: Two stars within the left market gate star are called Chariot Market—the district of many merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the left gate are Chariot Market stars for many traders.

sentences.zh: 帝坐一星，在天市中，候星西，天庭也。

translations.literal: Imperial Seat is one star in the Celestial Market, west of Observer Star—the celestial court.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Seat in the market west of Observer Star is the celestial court.

sentences.zh: 光而潤則天子吉，威令行。

translations.literal: Bright and lustrous—the Son of Heaven is auspicious and commands are enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Bright and moist means the emperor thrives and orders run.

sentences.zh: 微小凶，大人當之。

translations.literal: Slight dimness is inauspicious—great men bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Slight fading is ill-omen for great men.

sentences.zh: 侯一星，在帝坐東北，主伺陰陽也。

translations.literal: Observer Star is northeast of Imperial Seat—it watches yin and yang.
translations.idiomatic: Observer Star northeast watches yin and yang.

sentences.zh: 明大輔臣強，四夷開。

translations.literal: Bright and large means assistant ministers are strong and the four barbarians open.
translations.idiomatic: Brightness and size mean strong aides and open frontiers.

sentences.zh: 候細微則國安，亡則主失位，移則主不安。

translations.literal: If the observer is faint the realm is secure; if vanished the ruler loses position; if shifted the ruler is unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Faint observer means peace; vanished means lost throne; shifted means unrest.

sentences.zh: 宦者四星，在帝坐西南，侍主刑餘之人也。

translations.literal: Four Eunuch stars are southwest of Imperial Seat—attending punished and mutilated persons.
translations.idiomatic: Four Eunuch stars southwest attend the mutilated.

sentences.zh: 星微則吉，明則凶，非其常，宦者有憂。

translations.literal: Faint stars are auspicious; bright is inauspicious; if not as usual, eunuchs have worry.
translations.idiomatic: Faint eunuch stars are good; bright or abnormal ones trouble eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 斗五星，在宦者南，主平量。

translations.literal: Dipper is five stars south of Eunuchs—it governs leveling measure.
translations.idiomatic: Five Dipper stars south of Eunuchs level measure.

sentences.zh: 仰則天下斗斛不平，覆則歲穰。

translations.literal: If upturned, bushels and pecks are uneven across the realm; if overturned, the year is abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Upturned means uneven measures; overturned means abundance.

sentences.zh: 宗正二星，在帝坐東南，宗大夫也。

translations.literal: Two Director of Imperial Clan stars are southeast of Imperial Seat—clan grand masters.
translations.idiomatic: Two Clan Director stars southeast image clan grand masters.

sentences.zh: 慧星守之，若失色，宗正有事。

translations.literal: If a comet lodges there, or color fades, the clan director has affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Comet lodging or fading color troubles the clan director.

sentences.zh: 客星守動，則天子親屬有變。

translations.literal: If a guest star lodges and moves, the Son of Heaven's relatives change.
translations.idiomatic: Guest star motion changes imperial kin.

sentences.zh: 客星守之，貴人死。

translations.literal: If a guest star lodges there, nobles die.
translations.idiomatic: Guest star lodging kills nobles.

sentences.zh: 宗星二，在候星東，宗室之象，帝輔血脈之臣也。

translations.literal: Two Clan Stars are east of Observer Star—the image of the imperial clan, blood-kin assistant ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Clan Stars east of Observer image imperial blood kin.

sentences.zh: 客星守之，宗人不和。

translations.literal: If a guest star lodges there, clan members are discordant.
translations.idiomatic: Guest star lodging brings clan discord.

sentences.zh: 東北二星曰帛度，東北二星曰屠肆，各主其事。

translations.literal: Two northeastern stars are called Silk Measure; two northeastern stars are called Butcher Market—each governs its affair.
translations.idiomatic: Silk Measure and Butcher Market stars northeast each govern their trades.

sentences.zh: 天江四星在尾北，主太陰。

translations.literal: Celestial River is four stars north of Tail—it governs the Great Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Four Celestial River stars north of Tail govern the Great Yin.

sentences.zh: 江星不具，天下津河關道不通。

translations.literal: If river stars are incomplete, ferries, rivers, and passes are blocked across the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Incomplete river stars block rivers and passes.

sentences.zh: 明若動搖，大水出，大兵起。

translations.literal: If bright and wavering, great flood emerges and great armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Bright motion brings floods and war.

sentences.zh: 參差則馬貴。

translations.literal: If uneven, horses become expensive.
translations.idiomatic: Uneven stars make horses costly.

sentences.zh: 熒惑守之，有立王。

translations.literal: If Mars lodges there, a king is installed.
translations.idiomatic: Mars lodging installs a king.

sentences.zh: 客星入之。

translations.literal: If a guest star enters.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star enters,

sentences.zh: 河津絕。

translations.literal: river crossings are cut.
translations.idiomatic: river crossings are severed.

sentences.zh: 天籥八星，在南斗杓西，主關閉。

translations.literal: Celestial Key is eight stars west of the Southern Dipper handle—it governs closure.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Celestial Key stars west of the Dipper handle govern closing.

sentences.zh: 建星六星，在南斗北，亦曰天旗，天之都關也。

translations.literal: Establishment Stars are six stars north of the Southern Dipper—also called Celestial Banner, capital pass of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Six Establishment stars north of the Dipper are Heaven's capital pass.

sentences.zh: 為謀事，為天鼓，為天馬。

translations.literal: For planning affairs, the Celestial Drum, and the Celestial Horse.
translations.idiomatic: They govern planning, the Celestial Drum, and Celestial Horse.

sentences.zh: 南二星，天庫也。

translations.literal: The southern two stars are the Celestial Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: Southern pair is Celestial Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 中央二星，市也，鈇钅質也。

translations.literal: The central two stars are the market—and axe and mace.
translations.idiomatic: Central pair is market and axe-mace.

sentences.zh: 上二星，旗跗也。

translations.literal: The upper two stars are the banner base.
translations.idiomatic: Upper pair is banner base.

sentences.zh: 斗建之間，三光道也。

translations.literal: Between Dipper establishment is the path of the three luminaries.
translations.idiomatic: Between Dipper markers lies the luminaries' path.

sentences.zh: 星動則人勞。

translations.literal: When stars move, people toil.
translations.idiomatic: Star motion means popular toil.

sentences.zh: 月暈之，蛟龍見，牛馬疫。

translations.literal: If the moon is haloed, dragons appear and cattle and horses sicken.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar halos bring dragons and livestock plague.

sentences.zh: 月、五星犯之，大臣相譖，臣謀主；

translations.literal: If the moon or five planets strike, ministers slander one another and ministers plot against the ruler;
translations.idiomatic: Moon or five planets striking bring slander and regicide plots;

sentences.zh: 亦為關梁不通，有大水。

translations.literal: also passes and bridges are blocked and great flood comes.
translations.idiomatic: also blocked passes and great floods.

sentences.zh: 東南四星曰狗國，主鮮卑、烏丸、沃且。

translations.literal: Four southeastern stars are called Dog Country—it governs Xianbei, Wuhuan, and Woju.
translations.idiomatic: Four Dog Country stars govern Xianbei, Wuhuan, and Woju.

sentences.zh: 熒惑守之，外夷為變。

translations.literal: If Mars lodges there, outer tribes change.
translations.idiomatic: Mars lodging changes outer tribes.

sentences.zh: 太白逆守之，其國亂。

translations.literal: If Venus retrograde lodges there, that state falls into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Retrograde Venus lodging brings that state's chaos.

sentences.zh: 客星犯守之，有大盜，其王且來。

translations.literal: If a guest star invades or lodges there, great bandits appear and its king will come.
translations.idiomatic: Guest star strike brings bandits and the king's arrival.

sentences.zh: 狗國北二星曰天雞，主候時。

translations.literal: Two stars north of Dog Country are called Celestial Cock—it governs observing time.
translations.idiomatic: Two Celestial Cock stars north observe time.

sentences.zh: 天弁九星在建星北，市官之長也。

translations.literal: Celestial Cap is nine stars north of Establishment Stars—the head of market officials.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Celestial Cap stars north head market officers.

sentences.zh: 主列肆圜闠，若市籍之事，以知市珍也。

translations.literal: It governs ranked shops and round markets, market registers, and knowing market treasures.
translations.idiomatic: It governs shops, market lanes, registers, and market goods.

sentences.zh: 星欲明，吉。

translations.literal: Stars should be bright—auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Stars should shine bright for luck.

sentences.zh: 慧星犯守之，糴貴，囚徒起兵。

translations.literal: If a comet invades or lodges there, grain is expensive and convicts raise armies.
translations.idiomatic: Comet strike makes grain costly and convicts rebel.

sentences.zh: 河鼓三星，旗九星，在牽牛北，天鼓也，主軍鼓，主鈇钅質。

translations.literal: River Drum is three stars; Banner is nine stars north of Ox—Celestial Drum, governing military drums and axe and mace.
translations.idiomatic: Three River Drum and nine Banner stars north of Ox govern war drums and arms.

sentences.zh: 一曰三武，主天子三將軍。

translations.literal: Also called Three Warriors—they govern the Son of Heaven's three generals.
translations.idiomatic: Also Three Warriors for the emperor's three generals.

sentences.zh: 中央大星為大將軍，左星為左將軍，右星為右將軍。

translations.literal: The central great star is the Grand General; the left star the Left General; the right star the Right General.
translations.idiomatic: Center is Grand General; left Left General; right Right General.

sentences.zh: 左星，南星也，所以備關梁而距難也，設守阻險，知謀徵也。

translations.literal: The left star, the southern star, guards passes and bridges and repels danger—establishing garrisons at perilous passes, knowing stratagems and signs.
translations.idiomatic: The southern left star guards passes, holds defiles, and reads omens.

sentences.zh: 旗即天鼓之旗，所以為旌表也。

translations.literal: The banner is the River Drum's banner—the standard.
translations.idiomatic: The banner is River Drum's standard.

sentences.zh: 左旗九星，在鼓左旁。

translations.literal: Left Banner is nine stars beside the drum's left.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Left Banner stars sit left of the drum.

sentences.zh: 鼓欲正直而明，色黃光澤，將吉；

translations.literal: The drum should stand straight and bright, yellow color and luster—generals are auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: Straight bright yellow drums mean lucky generals;

sentences.zh: 不正，為兵憂也。

translations.literal: if not straight, military worry.
translations.idiomatic: crooked drums mean military trouble.

sentences.zh: 星怒馬貴，動則兵起，曲則將失計奪勢。

translations.literal: Angry stars make horses expensive; motion brings war; curvature means the general loses plan and power.
translations.idiomatic: Angry stars raise horse prices; motion brings war; bending loses the general's plan.

sentences.zh: 旗星戾，亂相陵。

translations.literal: If banner stars are skewed, chaos and mutual oppression.
translations.idiomatic: Skewed banners bring chaos and oppression.

sentences.zh: 旗端四星南北列，曰天桴。

translations.literal: Four stars at the banner tip, north-south in a row, are called Celestial Drumstick.
translations.idiomatic: Four tip stars north-south are Celestial Drumstick.

sentences.zh: 桴，鼓桴也。

translations.literal: Fu—the drumstick.
translations.idiomatic: Fu is the drumstick.

sentences.zh: 星不明，漏刻失時。

translations.literal: If stars are not bright, clepsydra marks miss time.
translations.idiomatic: Dim stars mean clepsydra error.

sentences.zh: 前近河鼓，若桴鼓相直，皆為桴鼓用。

translations.literal: Near River Drum ahead, if drumstick and drum align straight, both drumstick and drum are used.
translations.idiomatic: Aligned drumstick and drum near River Drum mean they are deployed.

sentences.zh: 離珠五星，在須女北，須女之藏府也，女子之星也。

translations.literal: Separated Pearls are five stars north of Xunu—Xunu's storehouse, stars of women.
translations.idiomatic: Five Separated Pearls north of Xunu are women's stars in Xunu's storehouse.

sentences.zh: 星非故，後宮亂。

translations.literal: If stars are not as before, the inner palace is disorderly.
translations.idiomatic: Abnormal stars disorder the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，後宮凶。

translations.literal: If a guest star strikes, the inner palace is inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Guest star strike harms the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 虛北二星曰司命，北二星曰司祿，又北二星曰司危，又北二星曰司非。

translations.literal: North of Void, two stars are called Director of Fate; north two Director of Emolument; north two Director of Peril; north two Director of Wrong.
translations.idiomatic: North of Void: Director of Fate, Emolument, Peril, and Wrong pairs.

sentences.zh: 司命主舉過行罰，滅不祥。

translations.literal: Director of Fate governs reporting faults, imposing punishment, and extinguishing ill omens.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Fate reports faults, punishes, and removes bad omens.

sentences.zh: 司祿增年延德，故在六宗北。

translations.literal: Director of Emolument extends years and virtue—therefore north of the Six Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Emolument extends years and virtue, north of the Six Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 犯司危，主驕佚亡下。

translations.literal: Striking Director of Peril means arrogance and dissipation destroy subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: Hitting Director of Peril brings arrogant rulers and ruined subjects.

sentences.zh: 司非以法多就私。

translations.literal: Director of Wrong means using law for private ends.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Wrong bends law to private ends.

sentences.zh: 瓠瓜五星，在離珠北，主陰謀，主後宮，主果食。

translations.literal: Gourd is five stars north of Separated Pearls—it governs secret plots, the inner palace, and fruits and food.
translations.idiomatic: Five Gourd stars north govern plots, the inner palace, and fruit.

sentences.zh: 明則歲熟，微則歲惡，后失勢。

translations.literal: When bright, the harvest succeeds; when faint, the harvest fails and the empress loses power.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Gourd means good harvest; faint means bad harvest and empress wanes.

sentences.zh: 非其故，則山搖，谷多水。

translations.literal: If not as before, mountains shake and valleys have much water.
translations.idiomatic: Abnormal Gourd shakes mountains and floods valleys.

sentences.zh: 旁五星曰敗瓜，主種。

translations.literal: Five stars beside are called Failed Gourd—they govern planting.
translations.idiomatic: Five Failed Gourd stars govern planting.

sentences.zh: 天津九星，梁，所以度神通四方也。

translations.literal: Celestial Ford is nine stars—a beam measuring spirit connecting the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Celestial Ford stars are a beam spanning the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 一星不備，津關道不通。

translations.literal: If one star is incomplete, ferry passes are blocked.
translations.idiomatic: One missing star blocks ferry passes.

sentences.zh: 星明動則兵起如流沙，死人亂麻。

translations.literal: Bright motion brings war like flowing sand and dead like tangled hemp.
translations.idiomatic: Bright motion brings war like sand and corpses like hemp.

sentences.zh: 微而參差，則馬貴若死。

translations.literal: Faint and uneven—horses expensive or dying.
translations.idiomatic: Faint uneven stars mean costly or dying horses.

sentences.zh: 星亡，若從河水為害，或曰水賊稱王也。

translations.literal: If stars vanish, harm comes from river water; or water bandits proclaim kings.
translations.idiomatic: Vanished stars bring river disaster or river kings.

sentences.zh: 東近河邊七星曰車府，主車之官也。

translations.literal: Seven stars near the river east are called Chariot Office—it governs chariot officials.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Chariot Office stars by the river govern chariots.

sentences.zh: 車府東南五星曰人星，主靜眾庶，柔遠能邇。

translations.literal: Five stars southeast of Chariot Office are called Human Star—it governs calming the multitude, soothing the distant and cherishing the near.
translations.idiomatic: Five Human stars southeast calm people and cherish near and far.

sentences.zh: 一曰臥星，主防淫。

translations.literal: Also called Reclining Star—it governs guarding against licentiousness.
translations.idiomatic: Also Reclining Star guarding against lust.

sentences.zh: 其南三星內析，東南四星曰杵臼，主給軍糧。

translations.literal: Three stars south split inward; four stars southeast are called Mortar and Pestle—they supply army grain.
translations.idiomatic: Split southern three and southeast four Mortar-Pestle stars supply army grain.

sentences.zh: 客星入之，兵起，天下聚米。

translations.literal: If a guest star enters, war rises and the realm gathers grain.
translations.idiomatic: Guest star entry brings war and grain hoarding.

sentences.zh: 天津北四星如衡狀，曰奚仲，古車正也。

translations.literal: Four stars north of Celestial Ford shaped like a balance are called Xi Zhong—the ancient Master of Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: Four balance-shaped stars north are Xi Zhong, ancient chariot master.

sentences.zh: 騰虵二十二星，在營室北，天蛇星主水蟲。

translations.literal: Soaring Serpent is twenty-two stars north of Encampment—Celestial Serpent governing water creatures.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-two Soaring Serpent stars north govern water creatures.

sentences.zh: 星明則不安，客星守之，水雨為災，水物不收。

translations.literal: When bright, unrest; if a guest star lodges there, rain and flood become disaster and aquatic goods are not gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Brightness brings unrest; guest star lodging brings flood disaster and lost aquatic harvest.

sentences.zh: 王良五星，在奎北，居河中，天子奉車御官也。

translations.literal: Wang Liang is five stars north of Kui, in the river—the Son of Heaven's chariot master.
translations.idiomatic: Five Wang Liang stars in the river north of Kui are the imperial chariot master.

sentences.zh: 其四星曰天駟，旁一星曰王良，亦曰天馬。

translations.literal: Its four stars are called Celestial Team; beside one star is Wang Liang, also called Celestial Horse.
translations.idiomatic: Four are Celestial Team; beside one is Wang Liang or Celestial Horse.

sentences.zh: 其星動，為策馬，車騎滿野。

translations.literal: When its stars move, horses are whipped and chariots and horsemen fill the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Motion whips horses and fills fields with riders.

sentences.zh: 亦曰王良梁，為天橋，主御風雨水道，故或占津梁。

translations.literal: Also called Wang Liang Bridge—the Celestial Bridge, governing wind, rain, and waterways; therefore sometimes interpreted for ferries and bridges.
translations.idiomatic: Also Wang Liang Bridge governing wind, rain, and crossings.

sentences.zh: 其星移，有兵，亦曰馬病。

translations.literal: If its stars shift, there is war; also called horse sickness.
translations.idiomatic: Shifting stars bring war or horse plague.

sentences.zh: 客星守之，橋不通。

translations.literal: If a guest star lodges there, the bridge is blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Guest star lodging blocks the bridge.

sentences.zh: 前一星曰策，王良之御策也，主天子僕，在王良旁。

translations.literal: One star ahead is called Whip—Wang Liang's riding whip, governing the Son of Heaven's servant, beside Wang Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Ahead is Whip, Wang Liang's riding crop for the emperor's servant.

sentences.zh: 若移在馬後，是謂策馬，則車騎滿野。

translations.literal: If it shifts behind the horse, this is called Whipping Horses—then chariots and horsemen fill the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Shifted behind the horse it whips horses and fills the plain with riders.

sentences.zh: 閣道六星，在王良前，飛道也。

translations.literal: Gallery Road is six stars before Wang Liang—the flying path.
translations.idiomatic: Six Gallery Road stars before Wang Liang are the flying path.

sentences.zh: 從紫宮至河，神所乘也。

translations.literal: From the Purple Palace to the river—where deities ride.
translations.idiomatic: From Purple Palace to river where gods travel.

sentences.zh: 一曰閣道，主道裡，天子游別宮之道也。

translations.literal: Also called Gallery Road—it governs roads, the Son of Heaven's path to separate palaces on pleasure tours.
translations.idiomatic: Also governs roads and pleasure routes to detached palaces.

sentences.zh: 亦曰閣道，所以捍難滅咎也。

translations.literal: Also called Gallery Road—warding off danger and removing blame.
translations.idiomatic: Also wards danger and removes fault.

sentences.zh: 一曰王良旗，一曰紫宮旗，亦所以為旌表，而不欲其動搖。

translations.literal: Also called Wang Liang Banner or Purple Palace Banner—also standards, and they should not waver.
translations.idiomatic: Also Wang Liang or Purple Palace Banner standards that should not waver.

sentences.zh: 旗星者，兵所用也。

translations.literal: Banner stars are what armies use.
translations.idiomatic: Banner stars serve armies.

sentences.zh: 傅路一星，在閣道南，旁別道也。

translations.literal: Auxiliary Road is one star south of Gallery Road—a side by-path.
translations.idiomatic: Auxiliary Road south is a side path.

sentences.zh: 備閣道之敗，複而乘之也。

translations.literal: Guarding against Gallery Road failure—return and ride again.
translations.idiomatic: Guards Gallery Road failure to return and ride again.

sentences.zh: 一曰太僕，主御風雨，亦遊從之義也。

translations.literal: Also called Grand Coachman—it governs wind and rain, also the meaning of travel retinue.
translations.idiomatic: Also Grand Coachman governing wind, rain, and travel escort.

sentences.zh: 東壁北十星曰天廄，主馬之官，若今驛亭也，主傳令置驛，逐漏馳騖，謂其行急疾，與晷漏競馳。

translations.literal: Ten stars north of Eastern Wall are called Celestial Stable—it governs horse officials, like today's post stations; governing transmitting orders, establishing posts, racing the clepsydra—called running urgently, competing with gnomon clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Celestial Stable stars north of Eastern Wall govern post horses racing time.

sentences.zh: 天將軍十二星，在婁北，主武兵。

translations.literal: Heavenly General is twelve stars north of Lou—it governs military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Heavenly General stars north of Lou govern war.

sentences.zh: 中央大星，天之大將也。

translations.literal: The central great star is Heaven's great general.
translations.idiomatic: The central great star is Heaven's commander.

sentences.zh: 外小星，吏士也。

translations.literal: Outer small stars are officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Outer small stars are officers and troops.

sentences.zh: 大將星搖，兵起，大將出。

translations.literal: When the great general star wavers, war rises and the great general emerges.
translations.idiomatic: Wavering great general star brings war and the general's emergence.

sentences.zh: 小星不具，兵發。

translations.literal: If small stars are incomplete, armies mobilize.
translations.idiomatic: Incomplete small stars mobilize armies.

sentences.zh: 南一星曰軍南門，主誰何出入。

translations.literal: One southern star is called Army South Gate—it governs challenging comings and goings.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Army South Gate star challenges traffic.

sentences.zh: 太陵八星，在胃北。

translations.literal: Great Mound is eight stars north of Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Great Mound stars north of Stomach.

sentences.zh: 陵者，墓也。

translations.literal: A mound (ling) is a tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Ling means tomb.

sentences.zh: 太陵捲舌之口曰積京，主大喪也。

translations.literal: The mouth of Great Mound Curled Tongue is called Accumulated Capital—it governs great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Curled Tongue mouth of Great Mound is Accumulated Capital, governing great mourning.

sentences.zh: 積京中星絕，則諸侯有喪，民多疾，兵起，粟聚。

translations.literal: If stars within Accumulated Capital are cut off, feudal lords have mourning, people many illnesses, war rises, grain gathers.
translations.idiomatic: Cut Accumulated Capital stars bring lordly mourning, sickness, war, and grain hoarding.

sentences.zh: 少則粟散。

translations.literal: If few, grain scatters.
translations.idiomatic: Few stars scatter grain.

sentences.zh: 星守之，有土功。

translations.literal: If stars lodge there, earthworks occur.
translations.idiomatic: Lodging stars bring earthworks.

sentences.zh: 太陵中一星曰積屍，明則死人如山。

translations.literal: One star within Great Mound is called Accumulated Corpses—when bright, dead like mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated Corpses within Great Mound bright means dead like mountains.

sentences.zh: 天船九星，在太陵北，居河中。

translations.literal: Celestial Boat is nine stars north of Great Mound, in the river.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Celestial Boat stars in the river north of Great Mound.

sentences.zh: 一曰舟星，主度，所以濟不通也，亦主水旱。

translations.literal: Also called Boat Star—it governs crossing, therefore ferrying where blocked; also governs flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: Also Boat Star for crossing blocked waters and flood-drought.

sentences.zh: 不在漢中，津河不通。

translations.literal: If not in the Han River region, ferries and rivers are blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Outside Han River region, rivers block.

sentences.zh: 中四星欲其均明，即天下大安。

translations.literal: The four central stars should be evenly bright—then great peace across the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Four even bright central stars mean realm at peace.

sentences.zh: 不則兵若喪。

translations.literal: Otherwise war or mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise war or mourning.

sentences.zh: 客彗星出入之，為大水，有兵。

translations.literal: If guest comets enter or exit, great flood and war.
translations.idiomatic: Guest comets bring flood and war.

sentences.zh: 中一星曰積水，候水災。

translations.literal: One central star is called Accumulated Water—it watches for water disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Central Accumulated Water watches floods.

sentences.zh: 昴西二星曰天街，三光之道，主伺候關梁中外之境。

translations.literal: Two stars west of Mao are called Celestial Street—the path of the three luminaries, watching passes and bridges and inner and outer borders.
translations.idiomatic: Two Celestial Street stars west of Mao watch borders and the luminaries' path.

sentences.zh: 天街西一星曰月。

translations.literal: One star west of Celestial Street is called Moon.
translations.idiomatic: West of Celestial Street is Moon star.

sentences.zh: 捲舌六星在北，主口語，以知佞讒也。

translations.literal: Curled Tongue is six stars north—it governs speech, knowing flattery and slander.
translations.idiomatic: Six Curled Tongue stars north govern speech and detect slander.

sentences.zh: 曲者吉，直而動，天下有口舌之害。

translations.literal: Curved is auspicious; straight and moving brings rumor harm across the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Curved is lucky; straight moving brings scandal.

sentences.zh: 中一星曰天讒，主巫醫。

translations.literal: One central star is called Celestial Slander—it governs shamans and physicians.
translations.idiomatic: Central Celestial Slander governs shamans and doctors.

sentences.zh: 五車五星，三柱九星，在畢北。

translations.literal: Five Chariots are five stars; Three Pillars nine stars north of Net.
translations.idiomatic: Five Chariots and nine Three Pillars north of Net.

sentences.zh: 五車者，五帝車舍也，五帝坐也，主天子五兵，一曰主五穀豐耗。

translations.literal: Five Chariots are the Five Emperors' chariot lodges and seats—they govern the Son of Heaven's five weapons; also said to govern abundance or scarcity of the five grains.
translations.idiomatic: Five Chariots are Five Emperors' lodges governing the emperor's five arms and grain harvests.

sentences.zh: 西北大星曰天庫，主太白，主秦。

translations.literal: The northwest great star is called Celestial Storehouse—it governs Venus and Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest great star Celestial Storehouse governs Venus and Qin.

sentences.zh: 次東北星曰獄，主辰星，主燕、趙。

translations.literal: The next northeast star is called Prison—it governs Mercury and Yan and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Next northeast Prison governs Mercury, Yan, and Zhao.

sentences.zh: 次東星曰天倉，主歲星，主魯、衛。

translations.literal: The next eastern star is called Celestial Granary—it governs Jupiter and Lu and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Next east Celestial Granary governs Jupiter, Lu, and Wei.

sentences.zh: 次東南星曰司空，主填星，主楚。

translations.literal: The next southeast star is called Minister of Works—it governs Saturn and Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Next southeast Minister of Works governs Saturn and Chu.

sentences.zh: 次西南星曰卿星，主熒惑，主魏。

translations.literal: The next southwest star is called Minister Star—it governs Mars and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Next southwest Minister Star governs Mars and Wei.

sentences.zh: 五星有變，皆以其所主而占之。

translations.literal: When the five planets change, each is interpreted by what it governs.
translations.idiomatic: Five planet changes are read by their domains.

sentences.zh: 三柱，一曰三泉，一曰休，一曰旗。

translations.literal: Three Pillars—also called Three Springs, Rest, and Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Three Pillars also Three Springs, Rest, and Banner.

sentences.zh: 五車星欲均明，闊狹有常也。

translations.literal: Five Chariot stars should be evenly bright, breadth and narrowness constant.
translations.idiomatic: Five Chariots should shine evenly with constant spacing.

sentences.zh: 天子得靈臺之禮，則五車、三柱均明。

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven obtains Spirit Terrace rites, Five Chariots and Three Pillars shine evenly.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit Terrace rites make Five Chariots and Three Pillars evenly bright.

sentences.zh: 中有五星曰天潢。

translations.literal: Within are five stars called Celestial Ford.
translations.idiomatic: Within are five Celestial Ford stars.

sentences.zh: 天潢南三星曰咸池，魚囿也。

translations.literal: Three stars south of Celestial Ford are called Salty Pool—the fish preserve.
translations.idiomatic: Three Salty Pool stars south are the fish preserve.

sentences.zh: 月、五星入天潢，兵起，道不通，天下亂，易政。

translations.literal: If the moon or five planets enter Celestial Ford, war rises, roads blocked, realm in chaos, government changes.
translations.idiomatic: Moon or planets entering Celestial Ford bring war, blocked roads, chaos, and regime change.

sentences.zh: 咸池明，有龍墮死，猛獸及狼害人，若兵起。

translations.literal: When Salty Pool is bright, dragons fall dead, fierce beasts and wolves harm people, as if war rises.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Salty Pool kills dragons, beasts harm people, like war.

sentences.zh: 五車南六星曰諸王，察諸侯存亡。

translations.literal: Six stars south of Five Chariots are called Various Princes—they observe feudal lords' survival.
translations.idiomatic: Six Various Princes stars south watch lords' fate.

sentences.zh: 西五星曰厲石，金若客星守之，兵動。

translations.literal: Five western stars are called Sharp Stone—if metal or a guest star lodges there, armies move.
translations.idiomatic: Five Sharp Stone stars west—metal or guest star brings armies.

sentences.zh: 北八星曰八穀，主候歲。

translations.literal: Eight northern stars are called Eight Grains—they govern watching the harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Grains stars north watch the harvest.

sentences.zh: 八穀一星亡，一穀不登。

translations.literal: If one Eight Grains star vanishes, one grain fails.
translations.idiomatic: One vanished grain star fails one crop.

sentences.zh: 天關一星，在五車南，亦曰天門，日月所行也，主邊事，主開閉。

translations.literal: Celestial Pass is one star south of Five Chariots—also called Heavenly Gate, where sun and moon travel; it governs frontier affairs and opening and closing.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Pass south governs frontiers, sun-moon path, and gates.

sentences.zh: 芒角，有兵。

translations.literal: Rays and horns—there is war.
translations.idiomatic: Rays and horns mean war.

sentences.zh: 五星守之，貴人多死。

translations.literal: If five planets lodge there, many nobles die.
translations.idiomatic: Five planets lodging kill many nobles.

sentences.zh: 東井鉞前四星曰司怪，主候天地日月星辰變異，及鳥獸草木之妖，明主聞災，修德保福也。

translations.literal: Four stars before Eastern Well's axe are called Director of Omens—it watches Heaven and Earth, sun, moon, stars, and changes, and omens of birds, beasts, plants, and trees; enlightened rulers hearing disaster cultivate virtue and preserve blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Omens before Well's axe watches cosmic and natural omens for virtuous rulers.

sentences.zh: 司怪西北九星曰坐旗，君臣設位之表也。

translations.literal: Nine stars northwest of Director of Omens are called Seated Banner—the model of ruler and minister placement.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Seated Banner stars northwest model court ranks.

sentences.zh: 坐旗西四星曰天高，臺榭之高，主遠望氣象。

translations.literal: Four stars west of Seated Banner are called Heavenly Height—the height of terraces and pavilions, governing gazing far at atmospheric signs.
translations.idiomatic: Four Heavenly Height stars west oversee distant weather signs.

sentences.zh: 天高西一星曰天河，主察山林妖變。

translations.literal: One star west of Heavenly Height is called Celestial River—it observes mountain and forest omens.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial River west watches mountain-forest omens.

sentences.zh: 南河、北河各三星，夾東井。

translations.literal: Southern River and Northern River are three stars each, flanking Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Three Southern and three Northern River stars flank Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 一曰天高天之闕門，主關梁。

translations.literal: Also called Heavenly Height's gate tower—it governs passes and bridges.
translations.idiomatic: Also Heaven's gate tower governing passes.

sentences.zh: 南河曰南戍，一曰南宮，一曰陽門，一曰越門，一曰權星，主火。

translations.literal: Southern River is called Southern Garrison—also Southern Palace, Yang Gate, Yue Gate, Power Star; it governs fire.
translations.idiomatic: Southern River is Southern Garrison, Yang Gate, Power Star—fire.

sentences.zh: 北河一曰北戍，一曰北宮，一曰陰門，一曰胡門，一曰衡星，主水。

translations.literal: Northern River is also Northern Garrison—also Northern Palace, Yin Gate, Hu Gate, Balance Star; it governs water.
translations.idiomatic: Northern River is Northern Garrison, Yin Gate, Balance Star—water.

sentences.zh: 兩河戍間，日月五星之常道也。

translations.literal: Between the two river garrisons is the regular path of sun, moon, and five planets.
translations.idiomatic: Between the rivers is the luminaries' regular path.

sentences.zh: 河戍動搖，中國兵起。

translations.literal: If river garrisons waver, war rises in China.
translations.idiomatic: Wavering river garrisons raise war in China.

sentences.zh: 南河三星曰闕丘，主宮門外象魏也。

translations.literal: Three Southern River stars are called Gate Mound—it governs the symbolic watchtower outside the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: Three Gate Mound stars are the palace gate watchtower.

sentences.zh: 五諸侯五星，在東井北，主刺舉，戒不虞。

translations.literal: Five Feudal Lords are five stars north of Eastern Well—they govern impeachment and guarding against the unexpected.
translations.idiomatic: Five Feudal Lords north of Well impeach and guard surprises.

sentences.zh: 又曰理陰陽，察得失。

translations.literal: It is also said to regulate yin and yang and observe gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: Also regulates yin-yang and weighs right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 亦曰主帝心。

translations.literal: Also said to govern the emperor's heart.
translations.idiomatic: Also governs the emperor's mind.

sentences.zh: 一曰帝師，二曰帝友，三曰三公，四曰博士，五曰太史。

translations.literal: The first is Imperial Teacher; second Imperial Friend; third Three Dukes; fourth Erudite; fifth Grand Historian.
translations.idiomatic: First Imperial Teacher, second Friend, third Three Dukes, fourth Erudite, fifth Historian.

sentences.zh: 此五者常為帝定疑議。

translations.literal: These five constantly settle the emperor's doubtful deliberations.
translations.idiomatic: These five settle the emperor's doubts.

sentences.zh: 星明大潤澤，則天下大治，角則禍在中。

translations.literal: When stars are bright, large, and lustrous, the realm is greatly governed; if horned, calamity is within.
translations.idiomatic: Bright large stars mean great order; horns mean inner calamity.

sentences.zh: 五諸侯南三星曰天樽，主盛饘粥，以給酒食之正也。

translations.literal: Three stars south of Five Feudal Lords are called Celestial Goblet—it stores gruel to supply proper food and drink.
translations.idiomatic: Three Celestial Goblet stars south supply proper food and drink.

sentences.zh: 積薪一星，在積水東，供給庖廚之正也。

translations.literal: Accumulated Firewood is one star east of Accumulated Water—it supplies the kitchen's proper provision.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated Firewood east of Accumulated Water feeds the kitchen.

sentences.zh: 水位四星，在東井東，主水衡。

translations.literal: Water Level is four stars east of Eastern Well—it governs water balance.
translations.idiomatic: Four Water Level stars east of Well govern water balance.

sentences.zh: 客星若水火守犯之，百川流溢。

translations.literal: If a guest star or water or fire lodges or invades, hundred streams overflow.
translations.idiomatic: Guest star or water-fire strike makes streams overflow.

sentences.zh: 軒轅十七星，在七星北。

translations.literal: Xuanyuan is seventeen stars north of Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen Xuanyuan stars north of Seven Stars.

sentences.zh: 軒轅，黃帝之神，黃龍之體也。

translations.literal: Xuanyuan is the god of the Yellow Emperor, the body of the yellow dragon.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanyuan is Yellow Emperor's god, the yellow dragon's body.

sentences.zh: 後妃之主，士職也。

translations.literal: Mistress of empresses and consorts—the office of scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Mistress of empresses; scholars' office.

sentences.zh: 一曰東陵，一曰權星，主雷雨之神。

translations.literal: Also called Eastern Mound; also Power Star—it governs the god of thunder and rain.
translations.idiomatic: Also Eastern Mound and Power Star, thunder-rain god.

sentences.zh: 南大星，女主也。

translations.literal: The great southern star is the empress.
translations.idiomatic: The great southern star is empress.

sentences.zh: 次北一星，妃也。

translations.literal: The next northern star is consort.
translations.idiomatic: Next north is consort.

sentences.zh: 次，將軍也。

translations.literal: Next—general.
translations.idiomatic: Next is general.

sentences.zh: 其次諸星，皆次妃之屬也。

translations.literal: The stars below are all subordinate consorts.
translations.idiomatic: Lower stars are subordinate consorts.

sentences.zh: 女主南小星，女御也。

translations.literal: A small star south of the empress is Female Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Empress's southern small star is Female Attendant.

sentences.zh: 左一星少民，少後宗也。

translations.literal: One star left is Lesser People—lesser empress clan.
translations.idiomatic: Left Lesser People star is lesser empress clan.

sentences.zh: 右一星大民，太后宗也。

translations.literal: One star right is Greater People—empress dowager clan.
translations.idiomatic: Right Greater People star is dowager clan.

sentences.zh: 欲其色黃小而明也。

translations.literal: They should be yellow, small, and bright.
translations.idiomatic: They should appear yellow, small, and bright.

sentences.zh: 軒轅右角南三星曰酒旗，酒官之旗也，主饗宴飲食。

translations.literal: Three stars south of Xuanyuan's right horn are called Wine Banner—the banner of wine officials, governing feasts and banquets.
translations.idiomatic: Three Wine Banner stars south govern feasts.

sentences.zh: 五星守酒旗，天下大酺，有酒肉財物，賜若爵宗室。

translations.literal: If five planets guard Wine Banner, great feasting across the realm, wine, meat, goods, bestowals like ennobling the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Five planets at Wine Banner bring realm-wide feasts and imperial gifts.

sentences.zh: 酒旗南二星曰天相，丞相之象也。

translations.literal: Two stars south of Wine Banner are called Celestial Minister—the image of the Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Two Celestial Minister stars south image the Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 軒轅西四星曰爟，爟者烽火之爟也，邊亭之警候。

translations.literal: Four stars west of Xuanyuan are called Signal Fire—signal fires are beacon fires, frontier post warnings.
translations.idiomatic: Four Signal Fire stars west are frontier beacon warnings.

sentences.zh: 爟北四星曰內平。

translations.literal: Four stars north of Signal Fire are called Inner Peace.
translations.idiomatic: Four Inner Peace stars north judge crimes.

sentences.zh: 少微四星，在太微西，士大夫之位也。

translations.literal: Lesser Supreme is four stars west of Supreme Palace—the position of scholar-officials.
translations.idiomatic: Four Lesser Supreme stars west are scholar-officials' seats.

sentences.zh: 一名處士，亦天子副主，或曰博士官。

translations.literal: Also called Recluse Scholar; also the Son of Heaven's deputy ruler; or said to be erudite officials.
translations.idiomatic: Also Recluse Scholar, deputy ruler, or erudites.

sentences.zh: 一曰主衛掖門。

translations.literal: Also said to govern guarding the side gates.
translations.idiomatic: Also guards side gates.

sentences.zh: 南第一星處士，第二星議士，第三星博士，第四星大夫。

translations.literal: Southern first star Recluse; second Counselor; third Erudite; fourth Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: South: Recluse, Counselor, Erudite, Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 明大而黃，則賢士舉也。

translations.literal: Bright, large, and yellow—worthy men are raised.
translations.idiomatic: Bright yellow stars raise worthy men.

sentences.zh: 月、五星犯守之，處士、女主憂，宰相易。

translations.literal: If the moon or five planets invade or lodge there, recluses and the empress are troubled, the Chancellor changes.
translations.idiomatic: Moon or five planets there trouble recluses and empress and change the Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 南四星曰長垣，主界域及胡夷。

translations.literal: Four southern stars are called Long Wall—they govern boundaries and Hu and barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Four Long Wall stars south govern borders and barbarians.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入之，胡入中國。

translations.literal: If Mars enters, Hu enter China.
translations.idiomatic: Mars entering brings Hu into China.

sentences.zh: 太白入之，九卿謀。

translations.literal: If Venus enters, the Nine Ministers plot.
translations.idiomatic: Venus entering makes Nine Ministers plot.
